rationale: DRAFT_UNSIGNED: proposes a standing signing authority for the autonomous scheduler under REQ-cycle-control-2 and decisions/ADR-0021-autonomous-cycle-authority.md. Names the first live cap: one $25 pack purchase plus bridge fees per cycle, a maximum of 72 cycles per day, both dashboard-editable within this ceiling but never past it. Confirms the two-layer kill switch (immediate off-chain pause flag; on-chain revocation of the vault-authorizer and policy-wallet keys, checked fresh on every signing request, never cached) as the actual stop mechanism, and confirms no new on-chain pause role is added (ADR-0021 cites architecture/trust-boundaries.md TB-07 by name). This draft grants no deployment, credential, signing, broadcast, asset-movement, spending, or publication authority by itself — it is the specific grant the signer service must see signed before it will produce any live autonomous signature.
